text.en:
WHEREAS, the Municipal Council of the same munic-
ipality in its Resolution No. 1, current series, has favor-
ably endorsed said petition; and
. WHEREAS, according to official information, no public
butldings such as the municipal building, have as yet
been constructed in the barrios of Dugo and Bulala;
NoW, THEREFORE, in the interest of the public welfare
and pursuant to the provisions of section sixty-eight of
the Revised Administrative Code, the seat of government
of the municipality of Camalaniugan is hereby transferred
from the barrios of. Dugo and Bulala to the barrio of
Dacallafugu in the said municipality.
This transfer shall take effect immediately.
Executive Order No. 276, series of 1949 is hereby re-.
Done in the City of Manila, this 28th day of May, in
the year of Our Lord, nineteen hundred and fifty-three,
and of the Independence of the Philippines. the seventh:
ELPIDIO QUIRINO
President of the Philippines
By the President:
MARCIANO ROQUE
Acting Executive Scoretary
